First, note Asia/Tokyo = UTC+9, Asia/Singapore = UTC+8 (historically consistent for this problem unless otherwise noted).  

Time in Tokyo: 15:00 (Nov 1, 1055)  
UTC offset Tokyo: +9  
UTC = 15:00 − 9 = 06:00 UTC (Nov 1, 1055)  
Singapore offset: +8  
Singapore time = 06:00 + 8 = 14:00 (Nov 1, 1055)  

FINAL_ANSWER: 14:00
